reviews.snippet: We recently had our mother’s cataract surgery at The Eye Foundation, Vadapalani, and we had a very pleasant and positive experience. From the initial consultation to the surgery and follow-up care, everything was well organized and handled professionally. We are especially thankful to Dr. Ankita Bisani, who is very kind, patient, and caring. She takes the time to understand each patient’s concerns and gives individual attention to everyone. We truly appreciate her dedication and the excellent care provided throughout the treatment. Overall, we are very happy with our experience at The Eye Foundation, Vadapalani, and would definitely recommend it to others. Thank you to the entire team for the wonderful care and support!
